item.description: On the same day that a college football game consisted of one second more than 60 minutes, another college football game had five minutes fewer than the usual amount.

item.title: NFL Commissioner Roger Goodell Receives Extension, Keeping Him In Job Through 2030
item.description: As another NFL season kicks off, the league’s top executive isn’t going anywhere. NFL owners have officially locked in Roger Goodell with a multi-year contract extension on Sunday morning.

item.title: LSU fans had a strong reaction to an image of Jayden Daniels on the video board
item.description: Three years after quarterback Jayden Daniels put together a Heisman-winning season at LSU, the attitude of the fan base has taken a sharp turn.

item.title: NFL announces new contract for Roger Goodell
item.description: Goodell is now signed through March 31, 2031.

item.title: Big Ten is using enhanced replay access this season, in Friday games only
item.description: Last night's controversial finish to the Western Michigan-Michigan game would have been somewhat less controversial if the Big Ten had deployed transparency in the replay process.
